title: CraftBench-UE: Deterministic Evaluation for Coding Agents in Unreal Engine
abstract: arXiv:2609.23142v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building gameplay features in a game engine requires more than code, as code that compiles and runs does not necessarily implement the requested gameplay. We introduce CraftBenchUE, an evaluation harness that runs agents in an isolated Unreal Engine environment, reconstructs their saved submissions in fresh projects, and applies deterministic build, asset, and runtime checks without an LLM judge. Based on the harness, we built a benchmark consisting of 70 tasks spanning C++ source, Blueprint assets, and editor scripting. We evaluate seven models under two editor-tool configurations, with a file-and-shell baseline on C++ tasks. We further pair tasks that specify the same gameplay and use the same runtime tests, but require C++ and Blueprint as the deliverables. translated_title: CraftBench-UE：面向虚幻引擎中编码智能体的确定性评估
translated_abstract: 在游戏引擎中构建玩法功能不仅仅是编写代码，因为能够编译和运行的代码并不一定真正实现了所要求的玩法。我们提出了 CraftBenchUE，这是一个评估框架，它在隔离的虚幻引擎环境中运行智能体，在全新项目中重建其保存的提交内容，并应用确定性的构建、资产和运行时检查，而无需 LLM 评判。基于该框架，我们构建了一个包含 70 个任务的基准测试，涵盖 C++ 源代码、Blueprint 资产和编辑器脚本。我们在两种编辑器工具配置下评估了七个模型，并在 C++ 任务上采用文件与 shell 基线进行对比。我们进一步将指定相同玩法并使用相同运行时测试、但分别要求以 C++ 和 Blueprint 作为交付成果的任务进行配对。在这 10 个配对任务中，两种工具配置下 C++ 的完成率分别超过 Blueprint 30.0 和 42.9 个百分点。在该配对集（中按时提交的 Blueprint 任务中……）
tldr: CraftBenchUE 是一个在隔离虚幻引擎环境中运行智能体、并通过无需 LLM 评判的确定性构建、资产和运行时检查来评估编码智能体的基准测试，揭示了在实现相同玩法时 C++ 的完成率显著高于 Blueprint。
en_tdlr: CraftBenchUE is a benchmark that runs coding agents in an isolated Unreal Engine environment and evaluates them via deterministic build, asset, and runtime checks without an LLM judge, revealing that C++ achieves substantially higher completion rates than Blueprint when delivering identical gameplay.
